title: Nullable column before backfill
task: Plan a schema change that records when a booking was confirmed. Read the schema fixture first. Do not apply it to a shared database.
contextNote: Read fixtures/bookings.sql. Write the migration under migrations/.

args.content:
-- rollback: ALTER TABLE bookings DROP COLUMN confirmed_at
ALTER TABLE bookings ADD COLUMN confirmed_at timestamp NULL;

simulatedScript.content: The fixture shows bookings with row count 2000000. Add confirmed_at as NULL first, backfill confirmed rows, then validate a constraint in a later migration. The artifact includes the rollback. I did not apply this to a shared database.
